pick.headline: Iran-Contra diversion announced; Poindexter resigns, North fired
pick.summary: On November 25, 1986, Attorney General Edwin Meese announced that proceeds from secret arms sales to Iran had been diverted to the Nicaraguan contras. National Security Adviser John Poindexter resigned and Lt. Col. Oliver North was dismissed.
pick.significance: The diversion turned an embarrassing arms deal into a constitutional scandal over a covert operation run from the White House in defiance of Congress's ban on aid to the contras.
pick.fbis: Havana's Radio Progreso said on November 26 that Reagan's credibility was in a 'spiraling descent', reporting Meese's disclosure that Iran's payments had gone to the contra leaders and that North and Poindexter had been fired.
